name: csr-issuance
description: Certificates API, both sides of it. Two ServiceAccounts hold the two mint primitives: `minter` has create+approval plus `approve` on the kube-apiserver-client signer (the fully-authorized KUBE-PRIVESC-011 shape), `signer` has `sign` on that signer plus the CSR status write (KUBE-PRIVESC-024). Four CSR objects then pin the evidence rules: a workload-requested approved client cert (fires), a legacy-unknown probe (fires), a denied request (must not), and the node-bootstrap CSR every kubeadm cluster carries (must not — this is the false positive that would make the certificates module noise on every real cluster).
